name: National Chemical Laboratory (NCL)
evidence: The official About page identifies National Chemical Laboratory (CSIR-NCL), Pune as a constituent laboratory of CSIR and a research, development and consulting organization; the official CSIR Labs page describes CSIR as an autonomous body, supporting autonomous_institute.
notes: Normal TLS failed with the exact self-signed certificate in chain error, so curl --insecure was used only for public GET requests to www.ncl-india.org.
